Hi Hilary / Clare House team,

Thanks again for the rapid follow-up on the London financial-services roundtable we discussed at the end of last year. We're aiming for a tight, invite-only evening (20–25 guests) in central London the week of March 21 — preference for Tues/Thurs. Two asks to get us moving:

1) Venue shortlist and high-level A/V capabilities (key for a short fireside + 2x breakouts). Please include: capacity seated dinner, breakout room sizes, and a sample AV rider.
2) NDA + contracting flow so our legal and the attendees from Aurora Capital can review — we often need a quick DocuSign route for venues and any sponsor NDAs.

Internal: Mina / Marcus / Laura — can you confirm target invite list (prelim) and any non-negotiable AV needs before I loop in Aurora? Marcus: two laptop feeds + streaming fallback, yes?

Hilary — if you can send over venue options, a ballpark quote, and NDA template by EOD Friday (UK time), that would help accelerate confirming dates. Attachment stubs are fine for now.

Thanks —
Priyom

Thanks Hilary — that Clare House option looks ideal (central, private dining). Quick notes from the invite perspective:

- Target guest list (20): 6 strategic clients (Aurora + 5 others), 6 potential mid-market prospects, 4 partners, 4 Redwood execs/PMs.
- Must-invite from Aurora: Amelia Price (confirmed interest), Ben Jacobs (TBC) — I'll coordinate final names this week.
- AV ask: Marcus, confirm we need two laptop HDMI feeds, table mic for fireside, livestream fallback (on-site encoder).

Priyom / Mina / Laura —

Checked Clare House rider. On-site kit includes: 2x laptop inputs (HDMI/USB-C via adaptors), 1x handheld mic, 1x wireless lapel. They do NOT include an encoder for live-RTMP streaming. Recommend we add a compact hardware encoder (Teradek-style) or bring a laptop-based encoder. Rough cost estimate: £350–£650 for one-off encoder hire.

Also recommend: run-of-show to include a 15-min tech check with speakers, and a separate press/recording policy slide to share with attendees.

I'll draft a short AV checklist and send it to Clare House Ops today.

— Marcus
Event Technical Lead
